question: A pair of articles was bought for ₹1,820 at a discount of 20%, and marked price of each article is same. What is the marked price (in ₹) of an article?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Selling Price of a pair (2 articles) after 20% discount = 80% of Total Marked Price.

80% = ₹1820

Total Marked Price (100%) = (1820 ÷ 80) × 100 = ₹2275

Since this is the total for 2 articles, Marked Price of 1 article = ₹2275 ÷ 2 = ₹1137.50

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1137.50.**
